title: Refusal as Structure: On Critique, Boundary, and the Public Life of Thought
source_native_claims: Critique is not merely pressure applied from outside; it is one of the ways thought learns the shape of its public surface.
Refusal can evade accountability but can also protect a boundary against false terms of entry; when refusal clarifies the conditions of contact it makes disagreement more honest.
